name: Telepathic
summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha; speak telepathically to creatures within 60 feet, and cast Detect Thoughts free once per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Telepathic Utterance
benefits.summary: Speak telepathically to a creature you can see within 60 feet, in a language you know.
benefits.text: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You speak in a language you know, so the creature understands you only if it knows that language. This doesn't let the creature reply to you telepathically.

benefits.name: Detect Thoughts
benefits.summary: Detect Thoughts is always prepared; cast it without a slot or components once per Long Rest.
benefits.text: You always have the Detect Thoughts spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot or spell components, and once you do so you can't cast it that way again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using spell slots of the appropriate level. Its spellcasting ability is the ability you increased with this feat.
